439077.overview:
UnDUNE II is an RTS game for the PICO-8.  It is a multi-cart game spanning 12 cartridges.

UnDUNE II is a demake of the classic  RTS game DUNE II, a strategy-based resource management simulation, where three houses fight for control of the planet Dune - the land of sand and home of the spice.

448253.overview:
Underworld Siege by Benjamin Soulé is a turn-based dungeon management game that was made for Ludum Dare 33 in 48 hours! You take control of the (presumably) evil demon at the centre of a modest dungeon that you must expand and defend against adventuring heroes. Dungeon Keeper comes to mind when playing this game. Beautiful Pico-8 graphics and clever gameplay make this a cart you definitely need to check out.

Underworld Siege was later expanded into a full game named The Wratch's Den for Windows, macOS, and Linux.

Because Soulé had to remove most of the ingame help to gain some space for late code you should REALLY read this before play :

MONSTERS :
Goblin : Fast and weak. The only monster who can carry gold and orbs.
Orc : Solid. Can dig faster than goblin
Skeleton : Slow but revive really fast.
Ghost : Hit hard and can't be targeted by projectiles. Can walk throught walls
Zombi : Durable but sluggish.
Dragon : Awesome at kicking heroes ass

HEROES :
Adventurer: Spirited and young enough to die.
Mage : Fire one deadly fireball
Knight : Hit hard and live long.
Thief : Picklock any door and move quickly
Archer : Fire up to 3x arrows

ITEMS : ( designed for heroes only, yeah...too bad )
Sword: Improve hero's attack
Meat : Improve hero's resistance
Boots : Improve hero's speed
Key : Open one door.
Spell : add one fireball spell
Gold pile : hero will steal 3 gold from your treasure

TEMPO BAR :

    Each time you move the tempo bar decrease
    When 0 is reached the next event occurd
    Event Hero : a hero will be added to the party
    Event Raid : the party will attack the dungeon
    Event Item : an item will spawn in the dungeon.

DIG TUNNELS :

    Only dirt can be digged
    Orc dig faster than goblins
    Each time a dirt square have two open neighbours, it changes to a wall.
    It wont apply if the two open neighbours are very distant allowing you to create loops
    Items will tends to spawn in deadends. Create some to make item defense easier.

GOLD :

    Find gold by digging tunnels ( you should use orc for this )
    Grab gold and bring it to the the master with goblins
    If your dungeon contain the treasure items, protect it or heroes will steal your gold

SHOP :

    Can be opened/closed with z key
    Shop content is randomly generated each game.
    You can recycle shop content with the central slot
    Recycle price decrease each time you buy something

448639.overview:
A short atmospheric platformer with metroidvania elements. Your UFO has been knocked out of the sky by scavengers and you're now trapped in their swampy junk yard. With the help of some friendly aliens, find a way to disable the electromagnetic pulse cannon that's keeping you from escaping.

This game was made in 10 days as a game jam entry for RNDGAME 2020.

451135.overview:
Christmas Eve 1988, an accountancy office party at the Sokitomi Plaza turns explosive as Terrorists take over the building. Only one man can stop them!

Pork Hardcheese... or is it Blast McRunfast... maybe it was Bacon Bigflank...

Fill the shoes of this 80s action hero, whatever his name is, in this retro action stealth adventure.

Save Hostages, Defuse Bombs, take out Terrorists. Leave behind no trace or stack up a large body count, it's your choice! Will you go easy or die hard?

452249.overview:
"Once upon a time, in a forest far, far away, there was a bear who loved nothing more than to eat. She would spend all day and night searching for food, gobbling up berries, fish, and anything else she could harvest.

As the years went by, the bear became more and more ravenous. She ate all the berries in the forest, then all the fish in the rivers and streams. Next, she turned her attention to the trees, devouring every last leaf and branch.

But still, the bear was not satisfied. She wanted more, and so she set her sights on bigger prey. She climbed to the top of the highest mountain and ate it all, leaving nothing behind but a barren peak.

Finally, the bear's hunger knew no bounds. She looked up at the night sky and saw the planets, shimmering and inviting. Without hesitation, she began to eat them one by one, swallowing each one whole.

 And so it was that the bear became the Ursa Maior, the great bear of the sky, her belly filled with all the wonders of the universe she did harvest."
